messages:
maria: quick q — can we add a deterministic eviction trace mode so we can replay and debug eviction decisions across restarts? postmortems keep hitting ambiguity (racey evict orders, different owner outcomes).
aj: +1 in principle. to be deterministic we need stable inputs: stable lease ids/epochs, deterministic tie-breaker (no random.choice), and record the exact observed metrics used for scoring.
lee: perf concern: logging every evict decision will be noisy. propose two modes: sampled continuous traces (1%) + capture-on-anomaly (triggered by high eviction churn, tail-latency spike, or explicit operator dump).
sam: agreed with lee. sketch of the minimal event schema I had in mind: one line per event, compressed. example: 

```jsonl
{"ts":"2025-10-12T14:03:22Z","tenant_h":"a1b2","prefix":"pfx:abc","owner":"node-07","lease_epoch":"42","reason":"score>threshold","score_before":123.4,"score_after":98.1,"decision":"evict","tie_breaker":"seq-1583"}
```

We can keep tenant as a hash for compliance. store as gzipped jsonl in s3 with an index per minute.
aja: (typo in name)
nina: small compliance note — tenant_h should be HMAC with tenant-specific salt or KMS-encrypted to avoid reversible tenant ids in hosted logs. Private deployments can opt out or send logs to customer S3.
aj: replay design: we record the exact inputs and the deterministic tie-breaker seeds. replay tool will load log and run same scoring code path with same weights and seed. CLI: `replay-evict --log s3://... --model-version v2 --dump-actions` Will print deterministic actions in order.
lee: implementation details: to keep runtime overhead low:
- keep in-memory circular buffer of recent events per-tenant (for immediate debug)
- async batch writer to s3 (no sync IO on hot path)
- optional binary delta-encoding for repeated fields

ops-bot: runbook created: /runbooks/evict-trace-spike (draft). Trigger: eviction-rate > 10% of hot-prefix ops for 5m.
maria: next steps I propose: 1) spike an efficient event capture (aj) 2) build replay tool (sam) 3) add capture-on-anomaly gating and canary the agent (lee) 4) compliance review and KMS integration (nina). volunteers?
aj: I can own the spike for capture + async writer. will prototype compression and indexing.
sam: I'll own replay tool + CLI. will mock logs and test parity.
lee: I'll add the anomaly triggers and perf sanity tests for canary.
nina: will own compliance doc and KMS integration notes; will pair for staging run.
maria: awesome. can we aim to have a tiny POC (capture + replay) in 2w? keeps us honest. :thumbsup:
lee: on perf thresholds, I'll add a perf test that writes 100k small events/sec to the async writer and measure impact — will post results in this thread.
ops-bot: FYI — created ticket EDG-938: evict-trace-poc, assigned to aj+sam+lee+nina.
maria: thanks all — if anyone spots additional gotchas (cache compaction, eviction-by-deadline vs score) drop a note.
